name: Cumberland County, NJ
findings: Cumberland County has 460 nonprofit organizations. 183 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 148 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cumberland County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Cumberland County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 148 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Cumberland County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 107 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 50 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few professional organizations list membership
observations.text: No professional organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through professional groups? Where else does that happen?
